references.text: The Lord sent his word and healed them, and he rescued them from the grave.

Surely, our sicknesses he took upon himself, and our pains he bore. Yet we considered him to be afflicted, struck by God and made miserable. But he was wounded for our transgressions, crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought us peace was on him, and by his wounds we have received healing.
And Jesus went throughout all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every affliction among the people.
And Jesus went through all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every affliction.

When the sun had set, all who had sick people with various diseases brought them to him. And he laid his hands on each one of them and healed them. Also evil spirits came out of many, crying out and saying: "You are God's Son!" But he rebuked them and did not allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Messiah.
In that same hour he healed many of diseases and afflictions and evil spirits, and to many blind people he restored sight.
